summary: Frontend visual/UX fix verification for Bracket. Verified: (a) Dashboard composer now dark (rgb(30,30,30)), no white/light panels detected; (b) Change Digest removed from /app (both change-digest-panel and dashboard-change-digest-wrap absent); (c) New Activity sidebar nav item present and routes to /app/activity, which renders activity-page + activity-empty-hint without crash; (d) Dashboard scanned for violet accent (#5E6AD2 / #8B95E8) — none found on dashboard. Project memory page (/project/9ea97afb-...) still renders with dark theme, horizontal pill tabs (Overview / Deliverables / Scope / Timeline / Requirements / Decisions / Deadlines) and no crash. Connect Work page loads dark. However, DOM scan found two elements on /app/connect still carrying color: rgb(94,106,210) (#5E6AD2): a provider-tile icon-wrapper SPAN (class 'inline-flex items-center justify-center rounded-lg shrink-0') and an IMG inheriting it. Visually the tiles render fine (logos are colored via their own artwork), but the leftover CSS color value indicates a missed accent replacement in Connect Work provider tile styling.

ui_bugs.issue: Icon wrapper span still uses violet color rgb(94,106,210) / #5E6AD2 (inherited by inner IMG). Not the unified blue accent. Visible on /app/connect provider tiles.

action_items: Replace remaining #5E6AD2 color on ConnectWork provider-tile icon wrapper (span.inline-flex ... rounded-lg shrink-0) with the unified blue accent #3B82F6 (or var(--accent)). Two matching nodes were found by computed-style scan on /app/connect.
critical_code_review_comments: Activity.jsx always renders both ChangeDigestPanel and EmptyHint. When digest returns null this is fine, but when digest has content, the empty hint still shows below it. Consider conditional rendering so the hint only appears when digest is empty.
Dashboard.jsx is ~590 lines and mixes list, filter, selection and card logic — nearing the 700 line threshold. Consider extracting ProjectCard / StatCard / selection bar to separate files.

seed_data_creation: None. Existing demo account has 21 projects (2 locked, 17 in progress).
context_for_next_testing_agent: Visual fixes for iteration_42 largely landed. Dashboard is fully dark, no white panels, no violet, Change Digest moved to Activity page reachable via sidebar. Only leftover violet accent found is on /app/connect provider tile icon-wrapper span (color:#5E6AD2). Project memory page still healthy. No console errors on dashboard/activity beyond two 404s for non-critical resources (likely favicon/logo variants).
rca of the issue: The provider tile icon wrapper on ConnectWork was not included in the accent color sweep. Its inline/CSS style still resolves to rgb(94,106,210). Fix: search the ConnectWork tile component and providersMeta for '#5E6AD2' / '#8B95E8' / 'rgb(94, 106, 210)' and replace with '#3B82F6' / 'var(--accent)'.
